description: This file is a comprehensive low-level design (LLD) document for the Leads module in vtiger CRM, describing its structure, key classes, data models, request workflows, database interactions, and internal logic. It consolidates detailed insights into the module's persistence, relationship handling, conversion processes, and various UI and backend workflows, based on the actual source code and implementation details of the Leads module and related core components.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Base class for all entity modules in vtiger CRM, providing generic CRUD operations, event triggering, and relationship management.

classes.name: Leads
classes.description: Module-specific class extending CRMEntity, encapsulating Leads metadata, relationship handling, export query, and related list retrieval methods.

classes.name: ConvertLeadUI
classes.description: Helper class for populating and validating lead data during conversion; provides methods to load lead info, determine owner info, and field availability.

methods.name: CRMEntity::save
methods.description: Performs validation and persistence of entity data into database tables, triggers events, and manages transaction boundaries.

methods.name: Leads::create_export_query
methods.description: Generates SQL query for exporting leads, joining main and related tables, applying access control, and filtering out converted or deleted records.

methods.name: Leads::transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records (activities, notes, products, campaigns) from source leads to a primary lead during merge or conversion.

methods.name: ConvertLeadUI::__construct
methods.description: Loads lead info and prepares owner assignment data for the lead conversion UI.

methods.name: vtws_convertlead
methods.description: Webservice function orchestrating the conversion of a lead into Account, Contact, and Potential entities, handling deduplication, related record transfer, and status update.

methods.name: vtws_transferLeadRelatedRecords
methods.description: Handles the transfer of all related records (notes, documents, activities, campaign relations, etc.) from lead to target entities.
